purpose: Literature-facing benchmark targets for post-run interpretation; values are not used by V2-08 computation or acceptance.

references.short_name: MSK-CHORD metastatic breast cancer line-start PFS
references.population: 2881 metastatic breast cancer patients, 8791 metastatic lines of therapy
references.prediction_time: start of each metastatic treatment line
references.comparability_to_v2: closest source/population context but different landmark, estimand, weighting, and evaluation protocol; do not directly rank IBS against V2 patient-balanced Brier

references.short_name: PREVAIL dynamic radiographic PFS from longitudinal PSA
references.population: 763 men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
references.comparability_to_v2: moderate conceptual comparator for incremental longitudinal information; single cancer, trial population, biomarker-driven, different horizon
dynamic survival-method comparator; much more structured follow-up and different disease setting

references.short_name: Serial CT imminent progression in advanced pancreatic cancer
references.endpoint: binary progression at next follow-up visit
references.comparability_to_v2: strong serial-imaging novelty comparator but binary next-visit endpoint rather than competing-risk PFS curves

references.short_name: 2025 systematic review of oncology dynamic prediction
references.population: 174 dynamic prediction models from 165 oncology studies
references.comparability_to_v2: field-level novelty and evaluation-rigor context; not a performance benchmark
